items.description:
Echo4x4 is an off-road caravan, trailer and 4x4 accessories business operating from outdoor premises in Kameeldrift, Pretoria. The centre fits and services rooftop tents, awnings and 4x4 accessories, alongside Iveco motorhome conversions and the manufacture of mining trailers for the industrial sector.

Customers can buy new and used caravans and trailers outright, or rent one for a weekend away, and the team can help arrange finance for a purchase. Fitment and servicing work covers both caravans and 4x4 vehicles, drawing on the business's dealer network to support customers beyond its Pretoria base. Based at Kameeldrift on the Derdepoort side of the city, the centre serves off-road and outdoor enthusiasts across Pretoria looking to fit out, maintain or finance a trailer, caravan or 4x4.

Eclectic Holdings is a management services company based in Ninapark, Akasia, set up to provide management services across a range of industries. The business focuses on delivering high-end management services to corporate clients, government departments, parastatals and unions, working through four distinct divisions.

Its structure spans Black Pearls and Pono Consulting on the consulting side, alongside Eclectic Investment Properties and Eclectic Landscaping and Horticulture, giving the group a reach that extends from corporate advisory work into property and grounds management. This divisional model allows Eclectic Holdings to serve high-end and corporate customers from a single base in Akasia, drawing on shared management experience and technology across the group rather than operating as a single-service consultancy.

Elke De Klerk Attorneys, Conveyancers and Notaries is a law practice in Eldoraigne, Centurion, providing attorney, conveyancing and notarial services. Its admitting attorney was admitted to practise before the High Court of South Africa in 1999, and the firm has built its practice around that admission ever since, focusing on the legal work that accompanies buying, selling, transferring or bonding a property, together with the certification of documents a notary is required to witness.

Current legal notices published under the firm's name show it still actively lodging matters with the Deeds Office and seeing property transfers through from instruction to registration, rather than having wound down the practice it set up in 1999. Operating from 1018 Saxby Avenue in Eldoraigne, the firm serves homeowners, buyers, sellers and estates across Centurion who need an attorney to manage a property transfer, draft or certify a notarial document, or handle a conveyancing matter through to completion.

Empyreal Construction (Pty) Ltd is a multi-disciplinary civil engineering construction company that has operated in Pretoria since 1997. The company is registered with the Construction Industry Development Board within the 8CEPE, 5GB scope and holds Level One BBBEE contributor status, working on water supply, roads, stormwater, sanitation and township development projects.

Its water division covers bulk water supply, distribution networks, storage reservoirs and pumping stations, while its roads and earthworks teams handle construction, rehabilitation and bulk earthworks. Stormwater work includes canals, piped systems and attenuation ponds, and sanitation projects range from outfall sewer pipelines to full sewerage treatment works. For township development, Empyreal installs internal services such as water and sewer reticulation for house connections, internal roads, paving, kerbing and Telkom or fibre sleeves, supported by its own plant resources and plant hire, from its premises on Moloto Road in Pretoria.

Emzansi Consulting Engineers is a multidisciplinary consulting engineering firm that has operated from Pretoria since 1993. The practice is based at Waterkloof Agricultural Holdings and covers electrical, mechanical, civil and structural engineering disciplines under one roof, rather than specialising in a single field.

Beyond core engineering design, the firm offers project management and facilities management services, along with renewable energy and developer-focused services for clients bringing new developments to market. This combination lets Emzansi support a project from initial design through to construction oversight and ongoing facilities needs. The practice works from its Waterkloof Agricultural Holdings offices on weekdays between 8am and 4pm, serving developers, property owners and businesses across Pretoria that need engineering expertise spanning several disciplines.

Energy Partners Refrigeration is the refrigeration division of Energy Partners, operating from Samrand Business Park in Centurion. The division designs, builds, operates and maintains industrial and commercial cooling systems for clients in food security, public health and data-integrity sectors where an uninterrupted cold chain is essential.

Its core offering is a Cooling-as-a-Service (CaaS) model that removes the risk of owning ageing refrigeration assets: Energy Partners takes full lifecycle responsibility for the plant, provides 24/7 monitoring and continuous performance optimisation, and tracks efficiency through its own EP Cooling Meter. Because the business funds the infrastructure itself, clients avoid upfront capital outlay and major future upgrade costs, with the investment treated off the client's balance sheet. The Centurion-based team works with businesses that depend on reliable industrial refrigeration but want to shift that operational and financial risk elsewhere.

Engen Centurion Golf Estate Convenience is a 24-hour filling station at the corner of Logan Avenue and John Vorster Drive in Highveld, Centurion. Alongside fuel, the site runs a Wimpy Drive-Thru, an Engen QuickShop convenience store and a car wash, giving motorists food, groceries and vehicle care in one stop.

The station positions itself on dynamic service and convenience, staying open 24 hours a day so drivers travelling through Centurion Golf Estate and the wider Highveld area can refuel, grab a meal or run through the car wash at any hour. Its combination of forecourt fuel, quick-service food and a QuickShop makes it a stopover point for both local residents and passing motorists, whether for a quick top-up or a longer stop while a vehicle is washed.

items.reason: Follow-up research (2026) confirms the business is still listed and trading: address 6794 Glendale Crescent, Eldo Ridge Estate, Centurion 0157 and phone 062 214 8243 are corroborated by a current directory listing and a Procompare.co.za result, categorised under construction of buildings. No reliable source, however, gives a founding date, project history, scale or any service detail beyond the bare directory listing, still too thin to expand into a full description without generic trade filler. Held for a deeper pass rather than published or closed.

items.description:
Ensol Technologies is a service-driven integrated building solutions company offering electronic security, building management and energy management services from Sinoville, Pretoria. Its security offering spans CCTV, access control, biometric and smart-card systems, boom gates, and automated doors and gates, built around a design philosophy of measuring, analysing and optimising each client's setup.

Beyond security installations, the company also supplies and installs generators, handles electrical work and air conditioning, carries out time-and-attendance system installations, and performs thermal scanning inspections on buildings. Ensol positions itself around delivering tailor-made, flexible solutions rather than one-size-fits-all packages, aiming to close gaps it identified in after-sales service and system support within the security and building management industry. The Sinoville-based team works with both residential and commercial clients needing integrated security, power backup or building management systems.

ERA Facilities Management Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a Level 2 B-BBEE facilities management company, majority owned by women, based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. The business specialises in the softer side of facilities management, offering cleaning services, catering, integrated facilities management covering maintenance, security and waste management, and wider business support services.

Its board draws on directors with decades of experience in service provision locally and abroad, and the company positions its hands-on director involvement, tailored solutions and adherence to regulatory standards as central to how it works with clients. ERA's B-BBEE contributions are built into its service model, benefiting both the businesses it serves and the broader economy. The Centurion-based team operates on weekdays from 7am to 5pm, serving corporate and institutional clients across Gauteng that need integrated facilities support.

Era Stene (Pty) Ltd, trading as Era Bricks, has supplied clay face bricks, clay stock bricks and cement bricks from Monument Park, Pretoria, since 1991. The business continues a brick-making tradition on the same site reaching back to 1942, making it one of the longer-running brick manufacturers still supplying the Pretoria building trade.

Its range covers three distinct brick types rather than a single product line, giving builders and contractors a choice between clay face bricks, clay stock bricks and cement bricks from one supplier. Operating under the Era Bricks trading name since 1991 while drawing on manufacturing roots dating back more than 80 years, the company has maintained continuity at its Monument Park premises through changes in ownership and branding over the decades. Builders, contractors and homeowners sourcing bricks for a Pretoria-area project can buy directly from a manufacturer with a long-standing local production history.

FACT, short for Future Africa Consulting and Training, is a South African-headquartered professional services company established in 2002 and based at Highgrove Office Park in Centurion. The business specialises in business process outsourcing for the engineering, telecommunications and IT industries, delivering network integration, network operations centre management, contact-centre management and telecommunications training.

FACT began with a single founder working from home, and has since grown to a staff complement of more than 260 people, most of them serving the ICT industry on projects across Africa and the Middle East. The company moved into its own purpose-built offices in Centurion in 2007 and was later recognised as one of 30 semi-finalists, selected from over 2,800 applicants across 15 countries, for the 2010 Legatum Africa Awards for Entrepreneurship. From its Highveld base, FACT continues to serve telecommunications and IT clients needing outsourced network and contact-centre operations across the continent.

Family Man Concrete Walls is a family-owned business that has manufactured and erected precast concrete walls across Pretoria and the Bronkhorstspruit area since 1972. Operating from Jan Niemand Park, the business produces its own wall panels and moulds rather than reselling someone else's range, giving it control over the quality of the material it installs.

Its product range includes 2 Louvre, 3 Louvre and Large Brick grey concrete walling, along with Clinker concrete walls and Clinker walls fitted with steel palisades, suiting both decorative boundary walls and more security-focused fencing. Panels are precast and cured under controlled factory conditions so that weather delays do not hold up a project. With more than 50 years in the trade, the business serves homeowners and property owners across greater Pretoria needing a new boundary wall built, repaired or replaced.

FEB Consulting is a Waverley-based automation and control engineering firm that has been in business since 1998. The company provides interactive monitoring systems, embedded software, instrumentation design and control systems integration, working across electrical, control and instrumentation disciplines for clients ranging from small businesses to large manufacturing plants.

FEB specialises in designing and supplying turnkey systems, drawing on a team with more than 25 years of combined military and industrial engineering experience to take a project from proof of concept through manufacturing and implementation. Its own factory in Waverley is equipped for high-volume, consistent production, and the company has also developed and distributed its own range of instrumentation products rather than relying solely on client-commissioned work. Pretoria businesses needing custom automation, blending systems or industrial computer hardware can draw on FEB's in-house design and manufacturing capability.

Fine & Country Pretoria Old East is a premium property estate agency operating under the international Fine & Country network from Waterkloof Heights. The office offers residential sales and letting and rental services, along with advice on new property developments and professional property appraisals for owners wanting to understand what their home is worth.

Being part of a global network gives the Pretoria Old East office access to Fine & Country's broader marketing reach while its agents work from local knowledge of the surrounding suburbs. The team is available on weekdays from 8am to 5pm, with Saturday and Sunday appointments arranged separately for clients who need to view or discuss a property outside office hours. The agency serves buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants across Pretoria's eastern suburbs looking for an agency with both local presence and international backing.

FoodNet SA (Pty) Ltd runs a tech-enabled fresh produce distribution platform from Waltloo, delivering daily to spaza shops and small food retailers in the Mamelodi area. The business sources fresh produce from Gauteng markets and local farmers each day, then distributes it on a daily delivery model so retailers are not forced to tie up cash in excess stock.

Orders are placed through WhatsApp or the FoodNet SA app in under 30 seconds, with no training required, and deliveries arrive at the same time each delivery day so shop owners can plan around a predictable schedule. By combining orders across hundreds of small shops, FoodNet SA secures market-scale pricing that it passes on directly, and every order is quality-checked before dispatch and replaced if it is not right on delivery. The model is built specifically for small food businesses working on tight cash flow and limited storage space in and around Mamelodi.

Fountain Square is a Green Star-rated office park in Monument Park with an atrium-shaped footprint offering roughly 4,477m² of multi-tenant leasable space. Large windows bring natural light into the building, with particularly strong views from the second floor, and the park was originally designed and built by GH Marais Incorporated with SSI Engineers & Environmental Consultants as its anchor tenant before ownership changed in 2001.

Tenants have access to a conference facility seating up to 30 delegates with its own private kitchen, a boardroom for 10, and an outdoor recreational deck seating up to 40 people for meetings or social functions, plus three ground-floor communal areas included at no extra cost. The building offers high-speed fibre internet, full air conditioning, an uninterruptable power supply backed by a generator, 24-hour security and 185 parking bays, with quick access to the R21 highway toward Pretoria, Fountains Circle and the N1. It suits businesses looking for office space with its own meeting and events infrastructure built in.

Foxtron Engineering is a precision sheet-metal fabrication company based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, founded in 1992. The business produces components for industrial and manufacturing clients using CNC and laser cutting technology, covering everything from custom prototypes and once-off parts through to high-volume production runs.

Foxtron holds ISO certification and built its operation around scalability, so a client can move from a small prototype batch to a full production run without changing suppliers. Its processes are designed to deliver consistent, accurate output while keeping turnaround times predictable, which matters to industrial clients working to tight manufacturing deadlines. The Centurion-based workshop serves businesses across South Africa that need reliable, repeatable sheet-metal fabrication rather than one-off custom work alone.

Fuge Design Studio is a boutique design agency established in 2008, working from the Pretoria area. The studio offers a full turn-key design service spanning brand strategy, branding and design, and UX/UI, web and digital design, working with clients that range from banks and fintech companies to law firms and startups.

Its process begins with strategy and blueprinting, including in-person sessions with a client's management team to align design work with business objectives, before moving into brand development covering logo, typography, voice and style guides, and company collateral such as stationery, packaging and brochures. On the digital side, the studio builds user experience and user interface work for websites and digital products. This methodology-led approach suits businesses wanting a single agency to carry a brand from initial strategy through to a finished digital presence.

Furniture Warehouse is a Gauteng furniture retailer trading since 2001, with a Doringkloof branch in Centurion that works on a view-pay-and-collect model. The store specialises in leather lounge suites and outdoor patio furniture, alongside dining tables, office furniture and coffee tables, with pieces proudly made in Gauteng rather than imported.

Outdoor ranges extend to teak wood, aluminium and recycled plastic furniture, all sold at what the retailer positions as factory-direct pricing, and same-day collection is available from both the Centurion and Randburg stores. Customers further afield can arrange nationwide delivery instead of collecting in person. The Doringkloof store is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm and Saturdays until 2:45pm, closed Sundays, serving Centurion shoppers looking to furnish a lounge, dining room, office or outdoor patio.

Future Coaches & Tours is a bus and coach hire operator based in Monavoni, Centurion, established in 1996. The company provides school bus hire for daily transport runs, alongside corporate and group transport services for businesses and organisations needing to move staff or groups of people together.

Its charter services extend to both long-distance and short-distance trips across South Africa, giving clients a single operator for anything from a local day outing to a multi-day cross-country tour. Having operated since 1996, the Centurion-based company has built up nearly three decades of experience arranging group travel for schools, companies and private groups. Organisations in and around Centurion needing reliable group transport, whether for a daily school run or an occasional corporate event, can draw on an operator with a long-standing local base.

G4 Civils (Pty) Ltd is a Black Empowerment civil engineering construction company based in Gauteng, operating since 1999. The business has grown into a major role player in South Africa's civil construction sector, specialising in road construction, bulk earthworks, land rehabilitation and reinforced concrete structures.

Its services division also handles stormwater, sewer and water reticulation work, together with routine road maintenance projects, with work carried out across Gauteng, Limpopo, North West and Mpumalanga rather than Pretoria alone. G4 Civils builds its BEE compliance and employment equity commitments into how it operates, framing skills development and equal opportunity as part of its contribution to South Africa's changing construction industry. The company suits government and private clients needing road, earthworks or municipal services infrastructure built across the wider region.

Gabbata Lodge is a bushveld guest lodge in Leeuwfontein, Roodeplaat, offering en-suite rooms with private bathrooms, air conditioning and a balcony or terrace looking onto garden, pool or lake views. A swimming pool with its own view and a sun terrace give guests space to relax between activities, and the lodge runs a family restaurant and bar on site.

Beyond overnight stays, Gabbata Lodge hosts weddings, professional conferences and private functions, drawing on its bushveld setting for events that want space away from the city. Guest reviews describe the lodge as a comfortable, well-appointed option in the area, with consistently positive feedback on its rooms and facilities. Set outside Pretoria near Roodeplaat, the lodge suits both overnight visitors and groups booking a wedding, conference or function in a bushveld setting.

Garsfontein Pretoria Electricians & Plumbers provides electrical and plumbing services across Garsfontein and the wider Pretoria East area, operating on a no call-out-fee, free-quote basis for both domestic and commercial customers. Electrical work covers emergency call-outs, fault finding, distribution board rewiring and circuit breaker repairs, generator and changeover switch installations, and appliance installs for stoves and ovens.

On the plumbing side, the team clears blocked drains, toilets, sinks and basins, fixes leaking geysers and burst pipes, carries out leak detection, and handles geyser replacements and bathroom renovations with new fittings. Having both trades under one roof means a single call-out can cover an electrical and plumbing issue at the same property. The business operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, for households and businesses in Garsfontein and Pretoria East needing an urgent repair or a planned renovation.

GC Solar Pretoria East is a branch of GC Solar, a national solar energy retailer trading since 2011, operating from Willow Crossing Shopping Centre in Die Wilgers. The branch supplies and installs inverters, solar panels and batteries for residential customers, while also offering dedicated support for commercial and utility-scale solar projects.

As a direct importer of solar products, GC Solar positions itself on competitive pricing and aftersales support, backed by a team of engineers who work on larger installations for utilities, mines and commercial buildings. The Pretoria East branch commits to on-time installation appointments and trained service from booking through to final sign-off. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays until 2pm, serving homeowners and businesses in Die Wilgers and Pretoria East looking to install or expand solar power.

Getec is a vehicle canopy and accessory manufacturer based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, producing steel and fibreglass canopies for bakkies and light commercial vehicles. Alongside standard canopies, the company carries out specialised vehicle conversions and supplies a wider range of motor vehicle accessories to fit out a vehicle beyond its factory specification.

Getec holds approved supplier status with several major vehicle manufacturers, including Nissan South Africa, Toyota South Africa and Ford South Africa, meaning its canopies and conversions meet the standards those brands require for vehicles sold through their dealer networks. Being based in Rosslyn places the business inside one of Pretoria's main vehicle manufacturing and assembly hubs, close to the plants of several of the brands it supplies. Fleet buyers, dealerships and individual vehicle owners needing a canopy, conversion or accessory fitted can draw on a manufacturer already trusted by major vehicle makers.

Giant Engineering cc is a roofing manufacturer based in Wonderboom, Pretoria, established in 1985. The company designs and produces timber, steel and concrete roof structures using MiTek design software, and is listed among MiTek South Africa's approved manufacturers for its engineered roof trusses.

Its product range includes SA Pine trusses manufactured up to 22 metres in a single piece, alongside connector plates, Posi-Strut and Posi-Joist systems, and PAMIR wall components produced through MiTek's engineering and automation machinery. Working within MiTek's supply chain network gives Giant Engineering access to engineered timber systems used by housebuilders and contractors across the roofing industry. The Wonderboom workshop operates Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm, closed over weekends, supplying roof trusses and related structures to builders and developers across Pretoria.

Glass Experts is a glass and glazing company based in Villieria, Pretoria, established in 1990. The business supplies and installs windows, glass, mirrors, doors, splashbacks, shopfronts and frameless shower screens across the greater Pretoria area, backed by in-house CNC glass cutting for glass up to 19mm thick.

As a registered member of the South African Glass and Glazing Association, Glass Experts works within national glass and glazing regulations and offers free professional quotations, a full guarantee on products and services, and after-sales backup for repairs. The company manufactures its own glass products rather than only reselling imported stock, giving it more control over turnaround and fit. Homeowners and businesses across Pretoria needing a shopfront, window, mirror or frameless shower installed or repaired can draw on more than three decades of local glazing experience.

Good Flavor Chinese Restaurant in Ninapark serves a broad Chinese menu alongside fresh sushi prepared to order, including maki rolls, a sushi platter, smoked salmon and sushi burgers, plus cooked dishes such as chicken and prawn chow fan, dumplings, tempura rolls and crispy cheese prawn spring rolls. Takeaway is available for customers who want to eat at home rather than dine in.

The restaurant ranks among the more visited Chinese venues in the Akasia area, with hundreds of customer reviews on sites such as Google and Zomato describing the staff as cheerful and the pricing as reasonable for the portions served. Its wider menu also covers soup, chicken noodles, chilli chicken, fried chicken and seafood dishes for diners wanting more than sushi. Open daily from late morning into the evening, the restaurant serves Ninapark and the broader Akasia area for sit-down meals or Chinese and sushi takeaways.

GQ Tissue Products (Pty) Ltd has converted tissue products from its Sunderland Ridge premises in Centurion since 2001. The company produces facial tissue, serviettes, toilet paper, kitchen towel, wet wipes and industrial wipes, sourcing raw materials from producers across three continents that hold ISO 9001 accreditation and environmental certification for responsible deforestation and replenishment.

Alongside its standard consumer range, GQ Tissue supplies an away-from-home line for commercial and institutional washrooms, built up over several years into what the company describes as a reputable product in that market, and it can also produce custom-branded tissue products for corporate functions and promotional use. The business was set up to offer quality tissue products at prices more accessible than the few dominant brands in the market. GQ Tissue operates Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, supplying retailers, washroom suppliers and businesses across the region.

Grey-Both Logistics is a freight transport company based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, with more than 15 years in the industry according to its Snupit profile. The company handles full container load and less than container load freight, air cargo, and abnormal-load transport for oversized or heavy cargo.

Its routes cover both domestic transport within South Africa and cross-border freight into the SADC and BLNS region of Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia and Eswatini, giving regional businesses a single logistics partner for local and cross-border moves. Operating with a small, specialised team, Grey-Both focuses on project and freight work rather than parcel courier services. Based in Elardus Park, the company serves Pretoria-area businesses that need freight moved locally or across neighbouring Southern African countries.

HBrianCustoms Garage is a mag rim and wheel specialist based in Eloffsdal, offering mag rim repairs, diamond-cut CNC work and powder coating for wheels that have been damaged, scratched or faded. The garage also sells wheels and tyres, giving customers a repair or replacement option depending on the condition of their rims.

Beyond wheel work, the garage carries out general automotive repairs, including engine, gearbox and suspension work, so a vehicle in for mechanical attention can also have its wheels refurbished in the same visit. This combination of specialist wheel refinishing and everyday mechanical repair work sets it apart from garages that only do one or the other. The Eloffsdal garage is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Saturdays until 1pm, serving motorists across Pretoria needing mag rim repairs, wheel sales or general vehicle maintenance.

HEALth-WorX Medical & Dental Centre in Raslouw is a multidisciplinary healthcare facility bringing general practitioners, dentists, podiatrists and physiotherapists together under one roof at the Raslouw Lifestyle Centre. The practice also offers pathology, radiology, orthodontic and family planning services, along with immunisations and psychology and nutrition consultations.

Travel medicine and aviation medicals are part of its specialised offering, serving patients who need vaccinations, travel health advice or medical certification for flying rather than only general check-ups. Patients can be seen on a walk-in basis or by appointment, giving flexibility for both routine care and more urgent same-day visits. The centre is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 6pm and weekends from 7am to 2pm, serving Raslouw and the wider Centurion area with a broad range of medical and dental services in a single location.

Heat Freeze Solutions is a heating, air conditioning and solar power company based in Sinoville, Pretoria, with almost a decade of experience in the industry. The business installs and services air conditioning units across all major brands, giving customers a single point of contact regardless of which brand they already have installed.

On the solar side, the company supplies and installs solar power systems of varying sizes for both residential and commercial customers, positioning solar as a sustainable and cost-effective alternative to relying solely on grid electricity. Heat Freeze backs its work with a guarantee on workmanship and customer satisfaction, aiming to deliver quality that exceeds expectations rather than just completing the minimum job. The Sinoville-based team serves homeowners and businesses across Gauteng needing air conditioning installation, servicing or a new solar power system.

HLE Hydraulics (Pty) Ltd is a hydraulics specialist with more than 25 years of experience, now based in Klerksoord after relocating from its former Silverton branch. The company repairs hydraulic systems on earthmoving equipment, cranes, and mobile and industrial machinery, running its own engineering shop along with cylinder and pump test facilities and a hydraulic hose assembly section.

Its hydraulic workshop has operated since 2004, and the business also specialises in locomotive parts, repairs and the manufacturing of hydraulic equipment, extending its work beyond earthmoving machinery into rail applications. HLE supplies and services multi-bank hydraulic control valves, designs and builds hydraulic cylinders, and stocks automotive and industrial lubricants, hydraulic oils, greases and brake fluid alongside its repair work. From Klerksoord, the company serves operators of earthmoving equipment, cranes and industrial machinery across Pretoria needing hydraulic repairs, parts or lubricant supply.

Hokaai Meat Market is a family-owned butchery with more than 30 years in the trade, with a branch in Centurion at the corner of Lenchen North and Embankment Road. The butchery sells beef, chicken, lamb and pork cuts, along with its own sausages and biltong, alongside a game processing service for customers bringing in their own venison.

Customers can also order meat hampers and biltong hampers for gifting or stocking up, and the butchery hires out spitbraai equipment for events needing a whole-animal roast. Online ordering is available for customers who want cuts prepared and either collected or delivered rather than selecting at the counter. As one of several Hokaai branches across Pretoria, the Centurion store gives local customers the same family-run butchery range and game processing service found at the group's other locations.

iLaw Corporation is a law firm based in Alphen Park, Pretoria, with more than 25 years of experience specialising in motor vehicle collision recovery and insurance claims. Rather than acting for individual claimants directly, the firm works on behalf of South African insurers, recovering damages from drivers found negligent in a collision.

This recovery work is carried out on a no-legal-fees basis for the insurers that instruct the firm, a model built around high case volumes in a single specialised area of law rather than a general legal practice covering many different fields. Decades of focus on motor vehicle collision claims has given the firm a specific body of experience in proving negligence and recovering costs after an accident. Insurers and related parties needing third-party recovery work handled by a specialist firm, rather than a general litigation practice, can turn to this Alphen Park-based team.

iLEAD et al is a Google Premier Partner digital advertising agency with more than 13 years of experience in online marketing, part of the wider et al Group. The agency specialises in search, display, video and shopping advertising through Google Ads, alongside search engine optimisation and website design for clients wanting a fuller digital presence.

Its service range extends to digital strategy and consulting, digital audits that benchmark a client's marketing against competitors, content marketing and copywriting, and location-based marketing that keeps a business's listings accurate across multiple platforms. Being a Google Premier Partner gives the agency a direct line to Google and access to tools and support not available to every digital marketer. Based in the Centurion area, iLEAD et al serves businesses wanting Google-certified management of their paid advertising and broader digital marketing.

Insel Attorneys is a boutique law firm with its main office on the eastern side of Pretoria and a second branch in Pretoria North. The practice handles criminal law matters including bail applications, drink-driving charges and wrongful arrest cases, alongside divorce and broader family law work.

On the commercial side, the firm advises on corporate and commercial law, including placing companies into liquidation and pursuing claims against companies on a client's behalf, and it also takes on debt collection matters. Insel positions itself as a boutique practice rather than a large firm, aiming to keep clients updated on their matters while keeping an eye on trial success and case closure rates. The Pretoria North and eastern Pretoria offices serve clients needing criminal defence, family law or commercial litigation handled by a smaller, more hands-on legal team.

Interchange runs a bureau de change branch inside Sunnypark Shopping Centre in Sunnyside, Pretoria, offering foreign exchange buying and selling alongside MoneyGram and Western Union money transfers. The branch is part of Interchange's wider South African network and is one of several outlets through which the company acts as a Western Union agent across multiple Southern African countries.

Customers can also use the Interchange FastCash mobile transfer application to send and receive money, with funds collectable from any Standard Bank ATM as an alternative to visiting the branch in person. As a MoneyGram partner operating across South Africa, Lesotho and Namibia, the branch gives Sunnyside shoppers a way to send or collect international transfers without needing a separate bank account. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, closed Sundays.

InXpress South Africa Head Office is the country head office for InXpress, a global shipping and logistics network, operating from Byls Bridge Office Park in Doringkloof, Centurion. The office coordinates courier and freight services for small and medium businesses, combining industry know-how with its own shipping technology platform rather than acting as a single-carrier broker.

Through its network, InXpress gives South African businesses access to competitive rates with multiple carrier partners without needing to manage separate accounts with each one, comparing live carrier options to help customers control shipping spend. The franchise model means local InXpress teams provide dedicated support while still drawing on a network that spans 14 countries for international reach. From its Centurion head office, InXpress South Africa oversees the local franchise network handling domestic and international parcel and freight shipping for South African businesses.

Irene Farm is a working dairy farm in Irene, Centurion, that has operated since 1895 and still runs its own dairy parlour alongside bees producing Irene Farm honey. Visitors can tour the farm to see the milking process, browse a farm shop and deli counter, or eat at one of two on-site restaurants, the Barn Restaurant and De Stoep Restaurant.

Beyond day visits, the farm hosts weddings, conferences, birthday parties, team-building days and a night market across a range of named venues on the property, from the historic Barn to open-air spaces such as Champion Field and Waters Edge. Deli platters and tastings give visitors a way to sample the farm's own dairy and other produce without booking a full meal. Operating for well over a century, Irene Farm combines a working agricultural operation with event and hospitality venues for visitors across the greater Pretoria and Centurion area.

Irrigation Unlimited is a strictly trade-only wholesale supplier of irrigation products, operating from Donkerhoek on the old Bronkhorstspruit road for more than 20 years. Rather than selling directly to the public, the business supplies dealers, outlets and agricultural co-ops across Southern Africa, distributing more than 5,000 irrigation-related products.

Its range spans valves and fittings, including butterfly and wafer valves, compression and camlock fittings, and PVC pipe fittings, through to specialised irrigation lines such as travelling irrigators, dripline irrigation, sweetwater float valves and irrigation filters under its AW product range. The business carries stock from a number of established irrigation brands, giving dealers a single wholesale source rather than ordering from multiple suppliers. Dealers and co-ops needing irrigation valves, fittings or dripline products can contact Irrigation Unlimited directly to be referred to their nearest stocking outlet.

Jakaranda Engravers is a laser engraving and cutting business based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, producing custom items such as trophies, medals, 21st keys and rubber stamps. The business engraves and cuts a wide range of materials, including stainless steel, brass, glass, leather, cork, ABS and perspex, rather than working with a single material type.

Its range extends to self-inking and wooden rubber stamps, sublimation gifts, laser-cut wooden boxes, and smaller items such as blank tags, keyholders, pins and name badges, with tiered pricing depending on order quantity. Although based in Rietfontein, the business takes custom orders by mail from customers across South Africa, not only those able to visit in person. Customers needing a personalised trophy, stamp, engraved gift or branded tag can specify the material and size and have it laser-cut or engraved to order.

JFS Technology (Pty) Ltd is a family-owned business consulting firm that has operated since 2002, based at Lynnwood Bridge in Pretoria. The company specialises in strategic management consulting, government policy formulation and the administration of government incentives for the automotive sector across Southern Africa and the wider continent.

What began as a single client relationship has grown into a firm trusted across several of Southern Africa's major industries, while remaining family run rather than becoming a large corporate consultancy. JFS draws on decades of board-level experience in both the private sector and national government to shape its advisory work, aiming its incentive and policy expertise particularly at foreign investors entering the South African market. The firm also sits within a wider network of ventures spanning mining, energy, manufacturing and technology, extending its reach beyond consulting alone.

JMCD Embroidery is a specialist embroidery and printing business based in Olympus, Pretoria, working across embroidery, sublimation, engraving, DTF and UV DTF printing. These different techniques let the business brand a wide range of items, from fabric-based promotional and corporate wear through to harder surfaces suited to engraving or UV printing.

Work wear and corporate clothing form a core part of the business, with embroidery and DTF printing used to apply company logos and branding onto garments ordered in bulk for staff or promotional giveaways. Typical turnaround on an order runs two to three days, letting businesses plan branded clothing or promotional items around a reasonably quick production cycle rather than a long lead time. Companies in and around Pretoria needing branded work wear, corporate clothing or promotional items can draw on a business built around several different printing and embroidery techniques under one roof.

JulieBean Artisan Coffee is a coffee roastery and cafe on Lynnwood Road in Menlo Park, roasting its own beans in house rather than buying in pre-roasted stock. Single-origin beans, including Colombian, Guatemalan, Ethiopian and Brazilian, are available to buy by the bag alongside the cafe's food and drink menu of chai lattes, toasted sandwiches and other cafe fare, all prepared on site.

The Lynnwood cafe doubles as the roastery itself, letting customers watch the barista and kitchen team at work rather than visiting a space with its roasting done elsewhere. Beyond the cafe, JulieBean On The Move brings a mobile coffee bar to weddings, corporate launches and private functions for hosts wanting a curated coffee service rather than a standard catering setup. The cafe opens Monday to Friday from 6am to 4pm and Saturdays from 7am to 2pm, serving Menlo Park and the wider Pretoria area.

Just Property Performers is a real estate office in Heritage Hill Estate, part of the Just Property network, which has helped South Africans with property sales and rentals for more than 25 years. The office works across residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural property, covering sales, rentals and property management rather than a single property type.

Being part of a larger network with offices across Southern Africa gives the Heritage Hill Estate office access to a wider pool of listings and buyer or tenant demand than a single independent agency could offer on its own, while still working from local knowledge of the Midstream Estate area. The agency positions its work around helping clients build wealth and financial security through property, whether that means selling a home, finding a rental, or managing an investment property. Buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants in and around Heritage Hill Estate and Midstream can draw on this combination of local presence and network-wide reach.

Just Sell Properties is an owner-managed real estate agency in Annlin West with more than 20 years of experience and a team of over 30 agents working across Pretoria and Centurion. The agency handles both residential and commercial property, covering sales and rentals rather than specialising in one side of the market alone.

Its listings span houses and apartments to let and for sale across areas including Annlin, alongside new residential developments and commercial space both for sale and to let, giving the agency a broad portfolio to match different buyer and tenant needs. The agency provides area profiles and property tools for clients researching a suburb before committing to a purchase or lease. Being owner-managed rather than a large franchise lets Just Sell Properties keep a more direct relationship between its agents and the Pretoria and Centurion clients it serves.

K.W. Pompe (Pty) Ltd supplies a wide range of pumps from its premises in Wonderboom, Pretoria, including borehole, booster, drainage, fire-fighting, pond and solar pumps. Beyond selling pumps, the business offers maintenance and repairs, along with irrigation system design and supply for both home gardens and farms.

As a distributor for JoJo water storage products, K.W. Pompe also stocks water storage tanks and related water filtration, sanitation and water monitoring equipment, extending its range beyond pumps alone into broader water management for rural and residential properties. This combination lets a customer source a pump, a storage tank and the irrigation fittings needed to connect them from a single Wonderboom-based supplier rather than several different outlets. Farmers, smallholders and homeowners across the Pretoria area needing pumping or water storage equipment, or repairs to an existing pump, can draw on this wider product range.
